title: Grover Adaptive Search with Problem-Specific State Preparation
summary: Grover's search algorithm is one of the basic building block in the world of quantum algorithms. Successfully applying it to combinatorial optimization problems is a subtle challenge. As a quadratic speedup is not enough to naively search an exponentially large space, the search has to be complemented with a state preparation routine which increases the amplitudes of promising states by exploiting the problem structure.
